title: Compaction and resume recovery
scope: existing session and current assignment, not a new project selection
moment: Context compaction, transcript resume, resumed ended session, restaffed worker or lost subscription
current: AGENTS requires reloading the current-phase skill after compaction. Skills have task/phase reentry and checkpoint rules. The lifecycle resume block reports claim reactivation; it is not a full context reload. Session orientation is delivered once per session and again after a context restart: SessionStart with source clear or compact (Claude, Codex) or Cursor's preCompact clears the orientation markers, so the next orientation event re-delivers the block. Cursor preCompact has no other dispatch branch. Live re-delivery after a real compaction is not yet measured on a released build.
planned: D should verify supported startup/resume/compact paths; P4 does not itself define a universal resume reset.
proposed_content: Rehydrate the current skill/phase, the agent rules file, scoped workflow instructions, live item stage/claim/lane and latest checkpoint before continuing.
Use durable item/strategy state and exact evidence pointers; do not replay completed transitions or restart onboarding merely because context was shortened.
Keep native transcript resume, ended-session reactivation and model-context compaction as distinct cases.
Add a short common recovery pointer to stable instructions; any automatic reinjection must be per supported harness/event and measured, not assumed.
